overview: The Medford Bicycle Advisory Commission received updates on local infrastructure and Blue Bikes expansion, and voted to endorse a pothole priority document as well as a letter supporting a city bike rack grant application.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: The commission approved the minutes from its previous meeting.

items.title: Announcements and Bike Rack Grant Support
items.summary: Commissioners shared updates on community events and working groups, and voted to approve a letter of support for a city bike rack grant application.

items.title: Reporting Channels, Governance, and Recruitment
items.summary: The commission reviewed preferred city channels for reporting bike rack requests, acknowledged the resignation of a member, and discussed ethics rules and recruitment strategies.

items.title: Pothole Priorities Guidance Document
items.summary: The commission voted to endorse a map and guidelines document to help city departments prioritize pothole repairs that pose severe safety hazards to cyclists.

items.title: Infrastructure Updates
items.summary: City staff presented updates on utility repaving, pavement marking management, the Clipper Ship Connector project, and the Green Line Extension bike path.

items.title: Blue Bikes Expansion and Commission Administration
items.summary: Staff shared locations for seven planned Blue Bikes stations, and members discussed social media management and potential collaboration with the Melrose bike committee.
